Ivy: Heads-up: ScalePulse invoice SP-2026-03 shows pilot Feb + renewal Mar charged together. Link: https://scalepulse.example/invoice/SP-2026-03
Priya: Please paste the invoice lines and PO. cc finance.
Ivy: Lines: Item: ScalePulse Pilot Feb 2026 - $5,600; Item: ScalePulse Renewal Mar 2026 - $11,200; Total: $16,800; PO: PO-118234
Marcus: Feb spike from scheduled benchmarking (run: bk-331). Not production. I'll attach logs.
procurement-bot: Ticket TKT-6402 created "ScalePulse double-charge + billing cadence & pricing pilot" assigned to Priya. SLA 72h.
Priya: Proposed asks: (1) pro-rata credit for pilot $5,600 (or credit note), (2) switch to consolidated quarterly billing starting 2026-05-01, (3) propose a 30-day flat-rate pilot for benchmarking windows as an experiment. Finance ok with credit note?
finance-bot: Finance prefers credit note applied to next invoice. If credit note > $3k, AP hold may be needed for reconciliation.
ScalePulse-Rep: Thanks for flagging. We can issue a credit note with run logs. For the flat-rate pilot, we can offer a 30-day capped plan at $8k — will need written acceptance and expected usage pattern.
Priya: Sounds good. We'll request credit note >= $5,600, legal will draft a short amendment for quarterly billing, and we'll evaluate the flat-rate pilot against a 6-week forecast. Marcus please upload logs to TKT-6402.
Ivy: Uploaded logs and forecast. Targeting close by Apr 14 to avoid manual reconciliations. Owners: @Priya (procurement), @Marcus (usage evidence), @Ivy (finance follow-up).
